stvc_shelf_watcher: Garza, watcher. This is the foot of Mosh'Ogg Shelf, the north-east corner of the middle jungle, and the ogres are up top. One road up and I am sitting on it. Write that down, it is the whole post.
stvc_basin_herbalist: Ordek Fenn, herbalist. This is Veilfall Basin, the west side of the middle jungle, under the falls. Sit down, sit down. I have not had anyone to be wrong at in weeks, and I have theories about that cave.
stvc_road_ganger: Dubo, road-ganger. Dis be de Vine Road, runnin' north to south down de middle of de jungle. Road's cut as far as de ford. After de ford it is cut as far as I was paid to.
stvc_gurbashi_broker: Zul'tamo, gatehouse broker. De Gurbashi Arena be right behind me, on de east side of de jungle. De ring runs one way. Dat is not a custom. Dat is masonry.
stvc_arena_tout: Bexxil, tout. Gurbashi Flats, outside the Arena - best pitch in Stranglethorn. You are on the board already. You were on it before you got here. Want to know your odds?
stvc_marsh_fisher: Ulua, netsetter. Dis be de Snapjaw Marsh, de south-west of de middle jungle. Nets are set. Nets have been set since before you were a rumour. What comes up in dem lately, I got no name for.
